Due to 35 or more red points, a follow-up inspection will be conducted for the red item violations noted in this inspection report. A fee of $240 will be assessed by mail for all follow-up inspections. If repeated red item violations are observed at a follow-up inspection, an additional follow-up inspection will be required. Notes: - Clean hood system of mobile unit to remove grease build up. - Keep personal food down, and away from customer items. Compliance Schedule OBSERVATIONS AND CORRECTIVE ACTIONS You must complete the following items by the due date listed below . Your inspector will do a compliance inspection . If these items are not corrected, you will be billed for the inspection. Violations cited must be corrected within the time frames specified . Complete ByItem Number 09/03/2026 2600 Compliance with valid permit; operating and risk control plans and required written procedures. 2600 Observed the following; - Homestyle ice machine on counter. - Countertop fryer added by steam table. - Unwashed lettuce in original packaging that had been cut. - Unwashed onions in drawers by order window. You must operate as approved . - Homestyle ice machine is not approved on the mobile unit. All equipment must be commercial. - Countertop fryer is not on approved floor plan. -Produce must be pre-rinsed at commissary and placed in food safe containers on the mobile unit. Remove homestyle ice machine from mobile unit. Send equipment specifications for countertop fryer to inspector for review. Do not use fryer until you have written approval. Remove unwashed produce from mobile. Discard unwashed cut lettuce. You have been found with operating outside of your approval for the third time in the last three inspection . If found again, you will be closed for 24 hours and billed $240 for a pre-opening inspection. You must have plan review approval before you change your menu or procedures . You can find a plan review application at www.tpchd.org/healthy-places/food-safety/opening-a-food-business. Call (253) 649-1706 if you need assistance. Contact your inspector with questions or if you need more time to complete these items. Due to 35 or more red points, a follow-up inspection will be conducted for the red item violations noted in this inspection report. A fee of $240 will be assessed by mail for all follow-up inspections. If repeated red item violations are observed at a follow-up inspection, an additional follow-up inspection will be required. Notes: - 2027 mobile sticker applied. - As of March 1, 2023, all food establishments must have a Certified Food Protection Manager. They need a certificate in food safety management from an accredited program. They take and active approach to train staff and prevent foodborne illness . - Facility plans on having the mobile rewrapped in the next few months. If the mobiles blue TPCHD sticker or 2027 mobile sticker, then bring mobile to the health department or contact inspector to have mobile re-stickered. - Facility wants to bring the 3rd mobile that is still in plan review to the sales site for the week this mobile is being wrapped. Ensure to apply for a temporary event permit for that mobile to operate at the sales site. Compliance Schedule OBSERVATIONS AND CORRECTIVE ACTIONS You must complete the following items by the due date listed below . Your inspector will do a compliance inspection . If these items are not corrected, you will be billed for the inspection. Violations cited must be corrected within the time frames specified . Complete ByItem Number 09/01/2026 2600 Compliance with valid permit; operating and risk control plans and required written procedures. 2600 Observed mobile not operating as approved. Observed the following: • In 2 drawer Atosa chef base cooler : fried shrimp 83F. Per PIC the fried shrimp had been parcooked on the mobile approximately 1 hour prior and then moved into the cooler to cool to 41F. • Mobile added a 2 basket electric fryer. The fryer was not located under the mobiles hood system. Fryer is not on the mobiles approved floorplan or equipment list. • Mobile added chicken strips and fries to the menu. Facilities approved menu does not include any deep fried foods. The mobile must operate as approved . Mobile unit operating conditions include: • No cooling of hot foods on the mobile. • All food cooked or hot held on the mobile must be discarded at the end of the day . You need plan review approval before you change your operating procedures . You can find a plan review application at www.tpchd.org/healthy-places/food-safety/opening-a-food-business. Call (253) 649-1706 if you need assistance. Fried shrimp was discarded. To operate as approved you must : • Only cool food at the commissary kitchen walk in 2 inches, uncovered until 41F or below. • Remove unapproved countertop fryer. Remove unapproved fried food such as chicken strips and french fries. • Discard all cooked or hot held food off the mobile at the end of the day . *A compliance order has been issued to operate as approved immediately . Failure to meet the approval conditions listed above by 9/1/2026 will result in a fee of $240 for non-compliance. Contact your inspector with questions or if you need more time to complete these items.
